name: Brumal-Tor
description: This is a world of broad skies and long sightlines, its map written in tectonic rift valleys. Travelers navigate by towering mountain ranges and by nothing else, because nothing else stands still.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
There is money in uranium here, and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
